name: 玄武岩衛
subject: A BASALT GUARD, full stocky humanoid of angular charcoal basalt plates, two stone fists and two legs, dull iron-grey shoulder slabs, restrained dark orange core cracks and an ancient stone mask face.

name: 炭焰蜥蜴
subject: A CHARFLAME LIZARD, complete four-legged low reptile with blackened charcoal scales, full curled tapering tail, rusty red flank stripes and tiny ember-orange throat highlights. No wings.

name: 火山甲蟲
subject: A VOLCANIC BEETLE, complete six-legged beetle with thick black-violet carapace, rusty copper mandibles, narrow dull orange seams and short curved horns.

name: 灰燼飛蝠
subject: An ASH-WING BAT, compact ash-grey furry bat with full rust-brown membranous wings, pointed ears, two small clawed feet, ember-amber eyes and a little soot on its fur.
